overall_notes: This paper focuses on analyzing and controlling language-specific neurons in decoder-based PLMs. The NLG evaluation is conducted through controlled text generation experiments (both unconditional and machine translation settings) using automatic metrics (language identification accuracy and BLEU). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of metrics and outputs.
